case_number: Civil Appeal No(s). 3153 of 2022 (@ SLP(CIVIL) No. 30193 of 2017)
summary: The case concerns the applicability of the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972 to Anganwadi workers/helpers, who are pivotal to the ICDS scheme. The key issue is whether such workers in the unorganized sector are entitled to gratuity as a statutory right under the Act. The Court examined the nature of social security legislation, emphasizing beneficial interpretation to extend protection to vulnerable workers. It discussed the historical development of gratuity laws, the definition of 'employee' under Section 2(e), and the need for inclusive construction to cover workers contributing to national development. The judgment highlighted that welfare legislation must be interpreted liberally to fulfill legislative intent and protect employee rights.
legal_provisions_cited: State Bank of India Vs. Shri N. Sundara Money
Bangalore Water Supply and Sewerage Board Vs. A. Rajappa
Steel Authority of India Ltd. & Ors. Vs. National Union Waterfront Workers & Ors.
final_judgment: The appeals were allowed, and it was held that Anganwadi workers/helpers are entitled to benefits under the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972. The Court directed the appropriate authorities to consider their claims for gratuity in accordance with law, affirming the need for extending social security to workers in the unorganized sector.
